_note: backend/railway.json is SHARED by api/worker/scheduler and therefore carries NO startCommand/healthcheck (config-as-code would override every service's dashboard). The api's startCommand comes from the Dockerfile CMD default (bash scripts/start-api.sh); the api's healthcheckPath=/health MUST be set in the api service's dashboard (Settings -> Deploy). The deploy block below documents the api's effective config but is NOT a file Railway reads.
